regenerationStatus: Source557: 51 runtime modules and six embedded arrays compiled/validated on CPU; 27 byte-identical and 30 diagnostic changes reviewed. Two crosshair arrays adopted in selected source. No native/GPU/headset acceptance.
correction535: Only source provenance comments and identity records changed; all shipped/embedded binary references remain exact.

sourcePreparation543.outputs: Fresh selected build directory only; no source/accepted blobs overwritten. Product-version includes are in product-version/, not generated/ shader headers.
sourcePreparation543.referencePolicy: No automatic adoption. Compare hashes/structure/disassembly and investigate every difference; no visual-equivalence claim.

correspondence544.compiler: glslang15.1.0 (reported11:15.1.0), generator11; Vulkan1.2 target emits SPIR-V1.5
correspondence544.unresolvedScope: Lighting outputs omit an accepted light-statistics guard; crosshair outputs add two readback array declarations from current shared input. No adoption or shader-algorithm edit; full recipe/source correspondence remains incomplete.
correspondence544.recordScope: Historical intermediate observation before the producing-input selection documented in correspondence545.

materialDifferences: ReadbackBuffer retains the exact six-member 32-byte normal prefix; B1 tone283/B2 lighting162/HF960 diagnostic word tails are removed. Parent storage binding5 changes accordingly; descriptor set depends on the shader recipe.

Ray shell tone witnesses and their atomics are removed. Actual prev_adapted_luminance frame latch remains under REFERENCE_VR_HISTORY after the first comparison exposed its B1 coupling; initial outputs are preserved as superseded.

ASVGF temporal/atrous lose only the HF capture helpers/calls and their otherwise unused included VBO/SSBO helper declarations. Ordinary samples, weights, history writes, fake specular and composite outputs remain in the complete expanded diff.
Tone curve/apply observation atomics/readbacks and their local witness-only barriers are removed. Normal accumulator, adapted luminance, display curve and output store remain.

Two standalone B1 diagnostic compute modules are omitted from final recipes; their initially generated review bytes are retained privately. Four of six embedded modules are byte-identical; both crosshair arrays are regenerated.
separation557.historicalRecords: correspondence544/545 and shader-input-provenance545.json are unchanged prior observations.
